description: This file implements the container object for the CCSP CWMP SoapParser component, including creation, initialization, object enrollment, and cleanup functions. It defines the core class methods and sets up the object structure, focusing on SOAP processing for CWMP protocol.

classes.name: CCSP_CWMP_SOAP_PARSER_OBJECT
